description: Describe one geo.admin.ch layer: title, abstract, data owner, whether it is queryable (identify/find work), time-enabled, attribute fields (name/alias/type + sample values) and legend/map links. Use before find_layer_features (to pick a search field) or to interpret query_layer_at_point attributes. Example: layer_id='ch.bag.radonkarte'.

lang.description: Language for labels/attributes: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

layer_id.description: geo.admin.ch layer id (BOD id), e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag', find ids with search_map_layers

name: get_layer_info
title: Get a geo.admin.ch layer's fields and metadata
